content: After naming the Imams as ūlū l-aydī wa-l-abṣār, 'men of might and vision' (Q 38:45), Ibn Turka says the manifestation of this supreme level of knowledge is peculiar to the present time, which Melvin-Koushki glosses as inaugurated by a significant celestial conjunction (saʿādat-qirān), a fact communicated to Ibn Turka by his teacher Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
